title: Maldives - Pure Isolation
overview_paragraphs: The Maldives does one thing better than anywhere on earth: total isolation on your own private sandbank, with an overwater villa and a lagoon so clear you can watch reef fish from your bed. This is a short, deliberately unhurried trip with almost nothing on the itinerary except the resort itself.
Built for honeymooners and anyone who wants a complete digital and decision-making detox.

itinerary.title: Arrival
itinerary.desc: Speedboat or seaplane transfer from Male to your overwater villa resort, with the rest of the day free to settle in.

itinerary.title: Resort Days
itinerary.desc: Snorkelling over the house reef, a sunset dolphin cruise, and an optional sandbank picnic on a deserted sandbar nearby.

itinerary.title: Spa & Free Day
itinerary.desc: A couples spa treatment and a free day to swim, paddleboard, or simply do nothing at all.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.desc: Speedboat or seaplane transfer back to Male for your international departure.
